title: Probability of Differentiation Reveals Brittleness of Homogeneity Bias in GPT-4

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the language model with single-word or expression completion tasks about human activities, using names or explicit labels associated with different racial and ethnic groups (African, Asian, Hispanic, and White American), and measuring the homogeneity of the outputs using the probability of differentiation metric.

Prompting the language model with single-word or expression completion tasks about human activities, using names or explicit labels associated with different genders (men and women), and assessing the variability of the generated representations using the probability of differentiation metric.
